answer: Concrete sybil resistance via shale layers: each agent must deposit a shale stake of 12,000 POA for 15 epochs; the stake erodes 5% per epoch unless refreshed by verified work. A grove of 9 rooted validators tracks each agent's lineage; any cluster sharing a root beyond depth 2 is frozen. Agents earn vine tokens that decay 8% per epoch without fresh attestations. An attacker running N sybils must fund 12,000N POA for 15 epochs and maintain 9 distinct validator groves, making cost scale linearly while detection probability compounds per head.
